These findings indicate that Suksdorfin may act as a modulator or inhibitor of Riboflavin synthase through its interaction with these downstream targets. The scores from the pathways suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact mechanism by which Suksdorfin influences Riboflavin synthase remains to be elucidated.
